PM Surya Ghar Scheme Boosts Rooftop Solar Capacity

India's rooftop solar capacity has reached 19,744 MW, driven by the PM Surya Ghar Scheme. Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Uttar Pradesh are leading in capacity addition, according to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).
